target_customer: Small and mid-market companies running vendor RFPs and procurement
problem: Enterprise procurement tools like SAP and Coupa need six-figure annual agreements, leaving small firms with spreadsheets.
business_model: Self-service B2B SaaS for RFPs, contracts and vendor tracking

founders.name: Michael Otis
founders.background_notes: Per Hypepotamus; YC page lists Ryan Muckel as founder, a conflict; stayed on as advisor after acquisition

founders.name: Ryan Muckel
founders.background_notes: Called co-founder of Procoto in the 2021-07-07 TampaBay.Ventures press release: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/tampabayventures-leads-investment-into-y-combinator-graduate-procoto-301327190

competitors.name: Coupa
competitors.what: Enterprise spend and procurement platform with six-figure annual agreements

technical_complexity.rationale: RFP workflow and vendor-tracking SaaS is standard CRUD-style engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Low switching costs and many alternatives; CB Insights lists several comparable RFP tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copied it; Bedrock, a small supplier-management startup, acquired it all-stock in June 2024.

market_need_then: Founders evaluated 30+ competitor products while building procurement at earlier startups and found enterprise tools too costly for small companies (YC launch post).

brand_strength.rationale: Press spells the name 'Protoco' and 'Procoto' inconsistently; no brand pull evidence.

outcome_analysis: Procoto offered self-service RFP management to small companies and was acquired by Bedrock in an all-stock deal announced June 2024 to fold into a procure-to-pay platform. Price and prior funding are undisclosed, so it is unclear whether this was a strong exit or a soft landing.
notes: Directory status Acquired agrees. Sources conflict on founder (YC: Ryan Muckel; Hypepotamus: Michael Otis, launch post credited to Michael Otis) and founding year (YC 2020, Hypepotamus 2019). Funding: Hypepotamus says it was TampaBay.Ventures' first investment after its 2021 launch; amount not found. Launch post undated (about 3 years old when read). Otis reportedly started a restaurant startup after the deal (CB Insights, unverified). Completeness pass: a July 7, 2021 press release says TampaBay.Ventures led a seed round, amount not disclosed. The release names Michael Otis and Ryan Muckel as co-founders. PitchBook and one other source describe a $750,000 pre-seed dated August 2022, which conflicts on date and is not recorded. Bedrock acquired the company on 2024-06-25 in an all-stock deal per Hypepotamus.
